problem.title: Construct String Without Three Consecutive Characters
problem.problemStatement: Given three integers representing the counts of characters 'a', 'b', and 'c', construct the longest possible string such that no character appears three times consecutively.
problem.input: • First line contains three integers A, B, and C.
problem.output: Print any valid longest string satisfying the condition.
